provenance: Authored by construction: each file has a deliberate syntax error at a known line, and the symbols that a recovering parser SHOULD still find are enumerated independently of any parser output.

cases.note: error is inside one def; the defs before and after are intact
unclosed paren swallows the following lines until the next def
indentation error inside a class body
Python 2 print statement -- valid Py2, invalid Py3
stray token between two valid defs

corrections.reason: Authoring error in v1.0.0. The unclosed bracket opens on line 2, so that is where the parse fails; line 3 is merely the first line consumed by the unterminated expression. Corrected before any parser comparison was scored. Scoring uses recoverable_symbols, which is unchanged.
